title: Runner sessions are holders, and verify separates holders instead of agents

story.as_a: headless runner session placed on a fleet machine
story.i_want_to: be a holder from the moment loopctl places me, with my session id and worktree recorded when my runner accepts
story.so_that: my claim, my verification and my history name me, and a session on the same runner is never mistaken for me

rationale: A placed session works under a dispatch key minted for the runner's agent (Placement.mint_session_dispatch/5, lib/loopctl/delivery/placement.ex:1216), and the claim names only that agent (:1161-1170). PRD R3 makes every session a holder; R4 requires the verifier of a self-modification to be a holder whose lineage shares no root with the implementer's, and verify_lineage_separated/4 (lib/loopctl/progress.ex:4508) still refuses on assigned_agent_id equality (:4522), which says nothing about sessions when every fleet session shares one agent. The runner is the only place a session's host is server-attested (PRD R4), so its holders are registered through placement and the runner socket, never by a host name a session reports.

acceptance_criteria.description: Placement.mint_session_dispatch/5 creates a holder of kind runner_session with the runner's agent_id, host = the runner row's name, dispatch_id = the new dispatch, session_id "dispatch:<dispatch_id>" and lease_until = the claim's DispatchLease cap, and the dispatch's api key is minted carrying that holder_id (Dispatches.create_dispatch/3 attr :holder_id, written by mint_and_link_key/4).
Placement.claim/6 passes the session holder's id to Progress.claim_story/3, so a placed story's assigned_holder_id is the runner session's holder.
Every placement undo that revokes the session dispatch (undo_claim/5 and claim_then_push/7's revoke) ends its holder in the same step; a placement that fails before the mint leaves no holder row.

Runner contract 1.34.0: RunnerDispatchReply with decision accepted may carry session_id (at most 200 bytes, no NUL) and worktree (at most 1024 bytes); DispatchLedger.record_reply/4 writes both onto the dispatch's holder and sets last_seen_at; a 1.33.0 accept without them is recorded as today and the holder keeps its placeholder session_id.
A session_ended message for a dispatch ends its holder (ended_at set, credential revoked) in RunnerStages.end_session/4's transaction; a replayed session_ended (replayed: true) changes nothing.

loopctl-runner generates the session uuid when it accepts (accepted_reply/1 sends it with the worktree path) and starts the Claude Code session with that same --session-id, so the holder's session_id equals the session's transcript id.

verify_lineage_separated/4 replaces the assigned_agent_id clause with holder identity: when the story has an assigned_holder_id and the verifier dispatch has a holder, verify is refused {:error, :self_verify_blocked} if the two holder ids are equal, and allowed past that clause when they differ even if the agent ids are equal; the empty-lineage and shared-root clauses before it are unchanged.
When either side has no holder (a story claimed or a verifier dispatch minted before this release), verify_lineage_separated/4 keeps the assigned_agent_id equality refusal it has today.

test_cases.name: a placement creates the session holder and the claim names it (DataCase)
preconditions: runner fixture with agent_id and name "x1"; contracted story; orchestrator caller as in test/loopctl/delivery/placement_test.exs
expected_results: one holders row kind runner_session host "x1" dispatch_id = session dispatch; api_keys.holder_id set on the dispatch key; story.assigned_holder_id = holder.id

test_cases.name: an undone placement ends its holder (DataCase)
preconditions: runner whose push fails (the existing push-refusal fixture)
expected_results: the holder has ended_at set; its key is revoked

test_cases.name: accept with and without the 1.34.0 fields (DataCase)
steps: a second placement accepted with a 1.33.0-shaped reply
a reply with a 201-byte session_id through RunnerContract.cast_dispatch_reply/1
expected_results: holder session_id and worktree written; placeholder kept; invalid_payload

test_cases.name: session_ended ends the holder once (channel test)
preconditions: joined RunnerChannel with an accepted dispatch (test/loopctl_web/runner_channel_test.exs setup)
expected_results: holder ended; second ack replayed: true and no second audit row

test_cases.name: runner sends the session id it then launches with
preconditions: loopctl-runner Control test harness with a fake socket (test/loopctl_runner/control_test.exs)
steps: deliver a dispatch; capture the accepted reply; let the start run with a stub launcher
expected_results: reply session_id equals the --session-id in the launcher argv

test_cases.name: verify separation by holder (DataCase)
preconditions: story reported_done with implementer and verifier dispatches of separate roots, both minted for agent A
case 1: different holders; case 2: the same holder id on both; case 3: verifier dispatch with no holder
steps: Progress.verify_story/4 in each case with orchestrator_agent_id = A
expected_results: case 1 passes the clause; case 2 self_verify_blocked; case 3 self_verify_blocked (agent equality kept)

test_cases.name: tenant isolation: another tenant's holder never matches (DataCase)
preconditions: a holder in tenant B with the same session_id
expected_results: nil, so tenant A's verify falls back to agent equality

technical_notes: Runner code is in /home/mkreyman/workspace/loopctl-runner until release 2 moves it to runner/ (README names table: runner source in this repo); edit it wherever it lives when this story is built. accepted_reply/1: lib/loopctl_runner/control.ex:1934-1939; accept_dispatch/3 :1944; Session.init/1 takes :session_id (lib/loopctl_runner/session.ex:321, uuid4/0 at :944) and argv/3 passes --session-id (:193-218). Thread the generated id from the accept through the pending start into Session's opts.

Contract: Loopctl.ApiSpec.RunnerContract @version "1.33.0" (lib/loopctl/api_spec/runner_contract.ex:436) becomes 1.34.0 with a changelog row in the module's table; RunnerDispatchReply :2651-2700; cast_dispatch_reply :4219, reply_shape_errors/1 :4229 gains the two optional fields on accepted only. Regenerate priv/runner_contract/v1.json with mix loopctl.runner_contract (lib/mix/tasks/loopctl.runner_contract.ex); once release 2 has moved the runner in, it reads that export from the repository root and nothing is re-vendored.

Server side of the accept: DispatchLedger.record_reply/4 (lib/loopctl/runners/dispatch_ledger.ex:1178), called from RunnerChannel's dispatch_reply handler (lib/loopctl_web/runner_channel.ex:369-386). session_ended: runner_channel.ex:438 -> RunnerStages.end_session/4 (lib/loopctl/delivery/runner_stages.ex:282).

Placement: mint_session_dispatch/5 placement.ex:1216-1232 (attrs map gets :holder_id), claim/6 :1161, undo_claim/5 :1404, claim_then_push/7 :932, revoke_session_dispatch/3 :972. Dispatches.create_dispatch/3 lib/loopctl/dispatches.ex:62, mint_and_link_key/4 :1174-1190. Holder creation runs before the mint so the key is born with holder_id; a refused mint ends the holder in the same rescue path.
Holders.register_runner_session/2 and Holders.holder_for_dispatch/2 join the context provided by US-52.13; assigned_holder_id and claim_story's :holder_id are provided by US-52.14.

Verify: verify_lineage_separated/4 progress.ex:4508-4528, clause :4522; verify_recorded_separation/2 :4482 is the only caller and is untouched. CLAUDE.md, Chain-of-Custody Enforcement step 4, is rewritten in the same commit to say holder identity replaces assigned_agent_id equality when both sides carry a holder.
VerifyVerdict (lib/loopctl/agents/verify_verdict.ex) applies verify@1 verdicts under a runner dispatch, so its verifier is a runner_session holder through this story.
non_goals: Holders for chg reviewer dispatches (Dispatches.mint_chg_reviewer/4): they claim nothing and are not sessions placed by loopctl.
Requiring the verifier on a different machine: US-52.12 (release 2) already does, by runner_dispatches and runners.name; this story changes only the lineage comparison.
Moving runner code into runner/: release 2.

failure_modes.partition: AC-52.15.4: a runner that loses the socket after accepting keeps working under its capped lease; its accept is resent on reconnect and the holder fields are written then.
failure_modes.state: AC-52.15.1: the runner session's holder is a holders row created by placement; the runner keeps only the session id it generated and sent (AC-52.15.6).
failure_modes.retry: AC-52.15.5: a replayed session_ended ends nothing twice; a resent accept with the same session_id writes the same values (AC-52.15.4).
failure_modes.slow: AC-52.15.3: a placement that times out after the mint undoes the claim and ends the holder in the same undo, so no live holder is left without a session.
failure_modes.reach: AC-52.15.1: a runner session is reached by its holder id through loopctl, which knows its runner (host) and dispatch; the runner process on that machine runs it.

defaults: Placeholder session_id for a runner on contract 1.33.0: "dispatch:<dispatch_id>".
worktree on the accept is optional because some kinds (triage, reply_draft) run in a scratch directory.
definition_of_done: After a real placement on x1: SELECT kind, host, session_id, worktree FROM holders WHERE dispatch_id = '<id>' returns runner_session, x1, the session's uuid and its worktree, and ~/.claude/projects on x1 holds a transcript named by that uuid.
